panels.title: Execution
panels.description:
The picked Run (Newest Live Run by default), at its newest second, whatever the Range. Green well, amber needs a look, red trading at risk, grey nothing to judge; an amount or a time plain.

- **Mode**: LIVE (real orders on Bitget) or PAPER (the program trades against its own copy of the books; nothing is sent): a Run is one mode, and every panel shows the picked Run only, so paper and live are never merged.
- **Run**: up for how long; starting (no sample yet); stale (no sample for more than 10 s and no stop recorded); lost (none for a minute: crashed or killed); stopped (in order).
- **Start / End**: when the Run started; for a stopped one, when it stopped; UTC+8.
- **Phase**: off hours (entries allowed), us regular (exits only), close window (flattening before the close).
- **Close**: the time left to the regular close that ends the session: everything is flat by then.
- **Anchor**: nav (both legs on the issuer's NAV), bell (F × Binance's index at the close, until the NAV is confirmed) or missing (no entries).
- **Books**: ok, or a leg whose book conflicts (snapshot and ticks disagree) or is unusable (too old or thin): no entry goes out on it.
- **Orders**: the Run's orders not final: n working, n unknown (being queried), or n left open by a stopped Run.
- **Entry**: the program's answer this second: ready (no signal yet) or order sent; the strategy's ordinary answers in grey (regular hours, spacing, quota used up, ...); held (waits on a book, F, the venue or a stop); stop (a person is needed).

            ELSE 'up ' || CASE WHEN ((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN ((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint < 60000 THEN (((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint / 1000) || 's' WHEN ((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint < 3600000 THEN (((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint / 60000) || 'm' WHEN ((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint < 86400000 THEN (((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint / 3600000) || 'h ' || lpad(((((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint / 60000) % 60)::text, 2, '0') || 'm' ELSE (((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint / 86400000) || 'd ' || lpad(((((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint / 3600000) % 24)::text, 2, '0') || 'h' END END AS "Run",
       CASE WHEN r.stopped_ms IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(to_timestamp((r.stopped_ms) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'MM‑DD HH24:MI') ELSE to_char(to_timestamp((r.started_ms) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'MM‑DD HH24:MI') END AS "Start / End",

       CASE WHEN r.stopped_ms IS NOT NULL THEN 'stopped' WHEN s.ts_ms IS NULL THEN 'no data' ELSE coalesce(nullif(concat_ws(' · ',

panels.title: Margin
panels.description:
The venue's side of the Run at its newest inventory sample (every 10 s). The program takes no decision from these (PRD 6.6); the board's own lines colour them.

- **Cycle**: flat, or the open round trip's side and how long it has been open (left open: a stopped Run's, in red).
- **Positions**: match (the venue's positions equal the ledger's), mismatch (no orders until a person checks) or not read.
- **Equity**: Bitget usdtEquity of the WHOLE account, USDT (it also holds the sibling repository's positions); paper: none.
- **Margin Ratio**: Bitget mgnRatio of the whole account (maintenance margin ÷ equity): ok below 30 %, warn below 60 %, high from there.
- **Liq Distance**: the nearer leg's liquidation price from its mark, in % of the mark: ok beyond 25 %, warn beyond 10 %, near within; flat without a position.
- **Quota**: held at entry prices plus open orders and dust, of the quota L × (M + min(0, R)).
- **Open P&L**: the open round trip at the newest second's mids against its entry cost, after its entry fees, before exit fees.
- **Funding**: booked to the Run's round trips, USDT (+ received), or the settlements still without a record (n awaited).

WITH sel AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.run_id, r.live, r.started_ms, r.stopped_ms, r.host, r.config, coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) AS end_ms
                         FROM trade.process_run r WHERE r.run_id = (SELECT CASE '$run' WHEN '__live' THEN (SELECT x.run_id FROM trade.process_run x WHERE x.live ORDER BY x.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1) WHEN '__paper' THEN (SELECT x.run_id FROM trade.process_run x WHERE NOT x.live ORDER BY x.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE '$run' END) AND coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bull,ticker}', 'SOXL') || ' / ' || coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bear,ticker}', 'SOXS') = '$combo'),
rg AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT greatest(sel.started_ms, (CASE WHEN '${since}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${since}' <> '0' THEN '${since}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${since_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${since_hour}'::int ELSE 0 END * 3600000 ELSE 0 END)) AS from_ms, least(sel.end_ms + 1, (CASE WHEN '${until}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${until}'::bigint < 99999999999999 THEN '${until}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${until_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${until_hour}'::int ELSE 24 END * 3600000 ELSE 99999999999999 END)) AS to_ms FROM sel),
     r AS (SELECT * FROM sel), sr AS (SELECT * FROM sel),
     s AS (SELECT * FROM trade.signal_sample s WHERE s.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND s.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND s.ts_ms <= (SELECT sel.end_ms FROM sel)
           AND s.ts_ms > (SELECT sel.end_ms FROM sel) - 172800000 ORDER BY s.ts_ms DESC LIMIT 1),
     i AS (SELECT * FROM trade.inventory_sample i WHERE i.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND i.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND i.ts_ms <= (SELECT sel.end_ms FROM sel)
           AND i.ts_ms > (SELECT sel.end_ms FROM sel) - 172800000 ORDER BY i.ts_ms DESC LIMIT 1), h AS (SELECT sum(l.entry_qty_bull - l.exit_qty_bull) AS q_bull,
             sum(CASE WHEN l.entry_qty_bull > 0 THEN l.entry_value_bull * (l.entry_qty_bull - l.exit_qty_bull) / l.entry_qty_bull END) AS v_bull,
             sum(l.entry_qty_bear - l.exit_qty_bear) AS q_bear,
             sum(CASE WHEN l.entry_qty_bear > 0 THEN l.entry_value_bear * (l.entry_qty_bear - l.exit_qty_bear) / l.entry_qty_bear END) AS v_bear,
             sum(CASE WHEN l.entry_qty_bull > 0 THEN l.entry_fee_bull * (l.entry_qty_bull - l.exit_qty_bull) / l.entry_qty_bull ELSE 0 END
                 + CASE WHEN l.entry_qty_bear > 0 THEN l.entry_fee_bear * (l.entry_qty_bear - l.exit_qty_bear) / l.entry_qty_bear ELSE 0 END) AS fee,
             max(c.direction) AS dir, min(c.opened_ms) AS opened_ms
      FROM trade.cycle c JOIN trade.lot l ON l.live = c.live AND l.cycle_id = c.cycle_id
      WHERE c.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND (c.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) OR c.cycle_id IN (SELECT dr.cycle_id FROM trade.decision dr WHERE dr.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND dr.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND dr.cycle_id IS NOT NULL)) AND c.status = 'open' AND l.status IN ('building', 'open')), lq AS (SELECT x.leg, x.d FROM i CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
  ('$bull', CASE WHEN i.pos_bull < 0 THEN (i.liq_bull - i.mark_bull) / nullif(i.mark_bull, 0) WHEN i.pos_bull > 0 THEN (i.mark_bull - i.liq_bull) / nullif(i.mark_bull, 0) END),
  ('$bear', CASE WHEN i.pos_bear < 0 THEN (i.liq_bear - i.mark_bear) / nullif(i.mark_bear, 0) WHEN i.pos_bear > 0 THEN (i.mark_bear - i.liq_bear) / nullif(i.mark_bear, 0) END)) x(leg, d)
  WHERE x.d IS NOT NULL ORDER BY x.d LIMIT 1)
SELECT CASE WHEN r.run_id IS NULL THEN 'no data' WHEN h.dir IS NULL THEN 'flat' WHEN r.stopped_ms IS NOT NULL THEN h.dir || ' left open'
            ELSE h.dir || ' · ' || CASE WHEN (least((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint, r.end_ms) - h.opened_ms)::bigint IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN (least((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint, r.end_ms) - h.opened_ms)::bigint < 60000 THEN ((least((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint, r.end_ms) - h.opened_ms)::bigint / 1000) || 's' WHEN (least((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint, r.end_ms) - h.opened_ms)::bigint < 3600000 THEN ((least((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint, r.end_ms) - h.opened_ms)::bigint / 60000) || 'm' WHEN (least((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint, r.end_ms) - h.opened_ms)::bigint < 86400000 THEN ((least((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint, r.end_ms) - h.opened_ms)::bigint / 3600000) || 'h ' || lpad((((least((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint, r.end_ms) - h.opened_ms)::bigint / 60000) % 60)::text, 2, '0') || 'm' ELSE ((least((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint, r.end_ms) - h.opened_ms)::bigint / 86400000) || 'd ' || lpad((((least((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint, r.end_ms) - h.opened_ms)::bigint / 3600000) % 24)::text, 2, '0') || 'h' END END AS "Cycle",
       CASE WHEN i.ts_ms IS NULL THEN 'no data' WHEN i.mismatch THEN 'mismatch' WHEN i.pos_bull IS NULL OR i.pos_bear IS NULL THEN 'not read'
            ELSE 'match' END AS "Positions",
       CASE WHEN r.run_id IS NULL OR i.ts_ms IS NULL THEN 'no data' WHEN NOT r.live THEN 'paper' WHEN r.stopped_ms IS NOT NULL THEN 'stopped'
            WHEN i.equity IS NULL THEN 'no data'
            ELSE to_char(i.equity, 'FM999,999,990.00') || ' U' END AS "Equity",
       CASE WHEN r.run_id IS NULL OR i.ts_ms IS NULL THEN 'no data' WHEN NOT r.live THEN 'paper' WHEN r.stopped_ms IS NOT NULL THEN 'stopped'
            WHEN i.margin_ratio IS NULL THEN 'no data'
            ELSE CASE WHEN i.margin_ratio < 0.3 THEN 'ok' WHEN i.margin_ratio < 0.6 THEN 'warn' ELSE 'high' END
                 || ' · ' || to_char(100 * i.margin_ratio, 'FM990.00') || ' %' END AS "Margin Ratio",
       CASE WHEN r.run_id IS NULL OR i.ts_ms IS NULL THEN 'no data' WHEN NOT r.live THEN 'paper' WHEN r.stopped_ms IS NOT NULL THEN 'stopped'
            WHEN coalesce(i.pos_bull, 0) = 0 AND coalesce(i.pos_bear, 0) = 0 THEN 'flat' WHEN lq.d IS NULL THEN 'no data'
            ELSE CASE WHEN lq.d < 0.1 THEN 'near' WHEN lq.d < 0.25 THEN 'warn' ELSE 'ok' END
                 || ' · ' || lq.leg || ' ' || to_char(100 * lq.d, 'FM999,990') || ' %' END AS "Liq Distance",
       CASE WHEN r.stopped_ms IS NOT NULL THEN 'stopped' WHEN i.quota_total > 0 THEN to_char(100 * i.quota_used / i.quota_total, 'FM990') || ' % used' ELSE 'no data' END AS "Quota",
       CASE WHEN r.stopped_ms IS NOT NULL THEN 'stopped' WHEN s.ts_ms IS NULL THEN 'no data' WHEN h.dir IS NULL THEN 'flat' ELSE coalesce(CASE WHEN CASE WHEN h.dir IS NOT NULL THEN (CASE h.dir WHEN 'short' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END) * (s.mid_bull * h.q_bull - h.v_bull + s.mid_bear * h.q_bear - h.v_bear) - h.fee END < 0 THEN '−' ELSE '+' END || to_char(abs(CASE WHEN h.dir IS NOT NULL THEN (CASE h.dir WHEN 'short' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END) * (s.mid_bull * h.q_bull - h.v_bull + s.mid_bear * h.q_bear - h.v_bear) - h.fee END), 'FM999,999,990.00') || ' U', 'no data') END AS "Open P&L",
       (SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE jsonb_typeof(c.funding_awaited) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(c.funding_awaited) > 0) > 0
                    THEN sum(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(c.funding_awaited) = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length(c.funding_awaited) ELSE 0 END) || ' awaited'
                    ELSE CASE WHEN coalesce(sum(c.funding) FILTER (WHERE c.funding_known), 0) < 0 THEN '−' ELSE '+' END || to_char(abs(coalesce(sum(c.funding) FILTER (WHERE c.funding_known), 0)), 'FM999,999,990.00') || ' U' END
        FROM trade.cycle c WHERE c.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND (c.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) OR c.cycle_id IN (SELECT dr.cycle_id FROM trade.decision dr WHERE dr.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND dr.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND dr.cycle_id IS NOT NULL))) AS "Funding"
FROM (SELECT 1) one LEFT JOIN r ON true LEFT JOIN s ON true LEFT JOIN i ON true LEFT JOIN h ON true LEFT JOIN lq ON true

panels.title: Alerts
panels.description:
What stopped or held trading in the picked Run and what became of it: the unfinished first, each group newest first, at most 200.

- **Severity**: critical: position mismatch, a lost or stale Run, an entry held for a person (settings, records, mismatch), a program error; serious: a sample gap, one leg only, a forced exit, an order rejected, unknown, never arrived or not found; warning: an entry held back (a book, F, no anchor, backing off, a stop pending), a stop or session end while holding, dust, funding awaited, an order not sent.
- **Status**: Open: a person is needed; In Progress: the program is still on it (only while the Run runs, else Open); Recovered: it ended by itself; Recorded: dust, recorded and not processed (owner item 47).
- **Time**: when it happened, UTC+8; for an entry held back, the start of its newest episode.
- **Source**: the part it belongs to: the Run, the positions, the entry, an order or a round trip (click a round trip's Source for its orders below).
- **What, Detail**: what happened, and its figures: for an entry held back, how often, how long in all and at most, and the seconds an executable deviation was past an entry line meanwhile (the entries it cost).

  UNION ALL

panels.title: Summary
panels.description:
The Run's round trips closed in the Range (row title).

- **Net**: Gross + Fees + Funding of the round trips closed in the Range, USDT: what the strategy earned (one whose funding is not known yet left out until it is).
- **Gross**: Both legs' fills, sells less buys, before costs.
- **Fees**: Trading fees, as a cost (negative).
- **Funding**: Funding booked to them; + received.
- **Open P&L**: The open round trip at the newest second's mids after its entry fees, before exit fees and the half spread an exit pays; not in Net.
- **Return**: Net over their entry notional, bps (of the notional, not D).
- **Win Rate**: Closed round trips with a positive Net.
- **Trips**: Round trips closed in the Range (no-fill ones left out).
- **Notional**: Both legs' entry value of those round trips, USDT.

WITH sel AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.run_id, r.live, r.started_ms, r.stopped_ms, r.host, r.config, coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) AS end_ms
                         FROM trade.process_run r WHERE r.run_id = (SELECT CASE '$run' WHEN '__live' THEN (SELECT x.run_id FROM trade.process_run x WHERE x.live ORDER BY x.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1) WHEN '__paper' THEN (SELECT x.run_id FROM trade.process_run x WHERE NOT x.live ORDER BY x.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE '$run' END) AND coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bull,ticker}', 'SOXL') || ' / ' || coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bear,ticker}', 'SOXS') = '$combo'),
rg AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT greatest(sel.started_ms, (CASE WHEN '${since}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${since}' <> '0' THEN '${since}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${since_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${since_hour}'::int ELSE 0 END * 3600000 ELSE 0 END)) AS from_ms, least(sel.end_ms + 1, (CASE WHEN '${until}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${until}'::bigint < 99999999999999 THEN '${until}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${until_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${until_hour}'::int ELSE 24 END * 3600000 ELSE 99999999999999 END)) AS to_ms FROM sel),
     r AS (SELECT * FROM sel), sr AS (SELECT * FROM sel),
     s AS (SELECT * FROM trade.signal_sample s WHERE s.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND s.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND s.ts_ms <= (SELECT sel.end_ms FROM sel)
           AND s.ts_ms > (SELECT sel.end_ms FROM sel) - 172800000 ORDER BY s.ts_ms DESC LIMIT 1),
     i AS (SELECT * FROM trade.inventory_sample i WHERE i.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND i.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND i.ts_ms <= (SELECT sel.end_ms FROM sel)
           AND i.ts_ms > (SELECT sel.end_ms FROM sel) - 172800000 ORDER BY i.ts_ms DESC LIMIT 1), c AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT c.*, (SELECT sum(x.entry_value_bull + x.entry_value_bear) FROM trade.lot x WHERE x.live = c.live AND x.cycle_id = c.cycle_id) AS notional
  FROM trade.cycle c WHERE c.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND (c.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) OR c.cycle_id IN (SELECT dr.cycle_id FROM trade.decision dr WHERE dr.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND dr.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND dr.cycle_id IS NOT NULL)) AND c.status <> 'open' AND c.closed_ms >= (SELECT rg.from_ms FROM rg) AND c.closed_ms < (SELECT rg.to_ms FROM rg) AND c.end_reason IS DISTINCT FROM 'no_fill'),
k AS (SELECT * FROM c WHERE c.funding_known), h AS (SELECT sum(l.entry_qty_bull - l.exit_qty_bull) AS q_bull,
             sum(CASE WHEN l.entry_qty_bull > 0 THEN l.entry_value_bull * (l.entry_qty_bull - l.exit_qty_bull) / l.entry_qty_bull END) AS v_bull,
             sum(l.entry_qty_bear - l.exit_qty_bear) AS q_bear,
             sum(CASE WHEN l.entry_qty_bear > 0 THEN l.entry_value_bear * (l.entry_qty_bear - l.exit_qty_bear) / l.entry_qty_bear END) AS v_bear,
             sum(CASE WHEN l.entry_qty_bull > 0 THEN l.entry_fee_bull * (l.entry_qty_bull - l.exit_qty_bull) / l.entry_qty_bull ELSE 0 END
                 + CASE WHEN l.entry_qty_bear > 0 THEN l.entry_fee_bear * (l.entry_qty_bear - l.exit_qty_bear) / l.entry_qty_bear ELSE 0 END) AS fee,
             max(c.direction) AS dir, min(c.opened_ms) AS opened_ms
      FROM trade.cycle c JOIN trade.lot l ON l.live = c.live AND l.cycle_id = c.cycle_id
      WHERE c.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND (c.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) OR c.cycle_id IN (SELECT dr.cycle_id FROM trade.decision dr WHERE dr.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND dr.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND dr.cycle_id IS NOT NULL)) AND c.status = 'open' AND l.status IN ('building', 'open'))
SELECT (SELECT coalesce(sum(k.net), 0) FROM k) AS "Net", (SELECT coalesce(sum(k.gross), 0) FROM k) AS "Gross",
       (SELECT -coalesce(sum(k.fees), 0) FROM k) AS "Fees", (SELECT coalesce(sum(k.funding), 0) FROM k) AS "Funding",
       (SELECT (floor((CASE WHEN h.dir IS NOT NULL THEN (CASE h.dir WHEN 'short' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END) * (s.mid_bull * h.q_bull - h.v_bull + s.mid_bear * h.q_bear - h.v_bear) - h.fee END)::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) FROM (SELECT 1) one LEFT JOIN s ON true LEFT JOIN h ON true) AS "Open P&L",
       (SELECT 10000 * sum(k.net) / nullif(sum(k.notional), 0) FROM k) AS "Return",
       (SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE k.net > 0) / nullif(count(*), 0) FROM k) AS "Win Rate",
       (SELECT count(*) FROM c) AS "Trips", (SELECT coalesce(sum(c.notional), 0) FROM c) AS "Notional"

panels.title: Spread · D and σ
panels.description:
The Run's newest second.

- **Spread**: D, on both legs' mids: 10⁴ × (F × (P_bull ÷ A_bull + P_bear ÷ A_bear) − 2); 1 D = 0.5 bps of the two legs' notional.
- **Mean**: D: the program's mean of the spread (the Run's mean model).
- **σ**: D: its standard deviation (the Run's σ window).
- **Deviation**: (Spread − Mean) ÷ σ, on the mids; the executable sides are in Entry below.
- **F**: USD per USDT the program converts the anchors with.
- **As Of**: The second these figures are of (UTC+8).

panels.title: Entry · σ and D
panels.description:
The Run's newest second.

- **Entry**: Can it open now: Ready (green, no signal yet) · Order Sent (green) · Blocked: the strategy's ordinary answer · Held Back (amber): waiting on the book, F, the venue or a stop · Needs a Person (red).
- **Why**: The reason in words (the program's idle reason this second), and after it a leg whose book keeps an entry from going out when that is not the reason itself (Regular Hours · SOXS Book Conflict).
- **Buy Both**: Now: the deviation buying both legs at their pricing levels, in σ (the band's top on the chart): a Long enters at −d_in σ · shown even while a book is not OK, for diagnosis.
- **Sell Both**: Selling both, in σ (the band's bottom): a Short enters at +d_in σ.
- **To Long Entry**: How far Buy Both still has to fall to the Long entry line (−d_in σ), in σ and in D; At the Line once there · —: a leg's book conflicts or its depth is unusable, so the program enters on none (Why names the leg).
- **To Short Entry**: How far Sell Both still has to rise to the Short entry line (+d_in σ) · — as for To Long Entry.

panels.title: Deviation from the Mean · σ
panels.description:
The deviation of the spread from its mean in σ, with the executable band, the program's lines and a dot at each decision, on the time picker's axis.

- **Deviation**: (Spread − Mean) ÷ σ, on the mids (purple).
- **Executable Band**: Buy Both (buying both legs at their pricing levels, top) to Sell Both (selling both, bottom), in σ; a band edge is its bucket's extreme, of the seconds whose books the program enters on (none, and tooltip Book Not OK, where a leg's book conflicts or its depth is unusable).
- **Long Lines, Short Lines**: a Long enters when the whole band is under the blue dashed line (Buy Both ≤ −d_in σ) and exits when it is over the blue dotted one (Sell Both ≥ −d_out σ); a Short enters over the orange dashed line (Sell Both ≥ +d_in σ) and exits under the orange dotted one (Buy Both ≤ +d_out σ); each sample on the lines of the run that wrote it.
- **Dots**: Long Entry (blue, large), Short Entry (orange, large), the exit in the round trip's colour (smaller, not in the legend), Forced Exit (red), Other (grey: a trim, a completion, or a void entry that filled one leg or none); hover a dot for the action, both legs' contracts and average prices, notional, fees and the round trip's net.
- **Shading and marks**: each round trip from entry to exit (blue Long, orange Short; its mark under the chart: times, end reason, net); purple marks: a change of the anchors in use, with reason and both legs' anchors before → after in USD and USDT (owner item 62).

panels.title: Round Trips · Newest First
panels.description:
Every round trip of the Run open at any time in the Range, newest first, at most 500; no-fill ones (nothing traded) left out.

- **Opened**: its first entry, UTC+8; click for its orders below.
- **Closed, Held**: its close, and open to close (to now while open).
- **Side**: Long: both legs bought; Short: both sold.
- **Notional**: both legs' entry value, USDT (a One Leg round trip: that leg's).
- **In σ**: the executable deviation at its entries, weighted by their value.
- **Out σ**: at the exit decision (– for a forced exit or none).
- **Net**: Gross + Fees + Funding, USDT; Open while open, Pending (amber) while a funding settlement it held through has no record.
- **Net Bps**: Net ÷ Notional × 10⁴ (bps of the notional, not D).
- **End Reason**: why it closed.

panels.title: Orders · ct, USDT and ms
panels.description:
Every order of the picked round trip (the Range's newest by default), in the order the program sent them, its fills folded in.

- **Purpose**: Entry, Complete (the leg that filled less), Trim (the leg that filled more), Exit, Forced.
- **Side**: Buy or Sell; RO: a reduce-only order.
- **Qty, Filled**: contracts ordered and filled.
- **Limit, Avg**: the limit and the fills' average price, USDT, to the leg's tick.
- **Fee**: USDT, as a contribution (a cost negative); Pending while the venue has not reported it.
- **Latency**: sent → final state in hand, ms, this host's clock (paper: the configured simulation).
- **Status**: Filled, Partial, No Fill (an IOC that met nothing), Rejected (with the venue's code), Working, Unknown (being queried).

WITH sel AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.run_id, r.live, r.started_ms, r.stopped_ms, r.host, r.config, coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) AS end_ms
                         FROM trade.process_run r WHERE r.run_id = (SELECT CASE '$run' WHEN '__live' THEN (SELECT x.run_id FROM trade.process_run x WHERE x.live ORDER BY x.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1) WHEN '__paper' THEN (SELECT x.run_id FROM trade.process_run x WHERE NOT x.live ORDER BY x.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE '$run' END) AND coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bull,ticker}', 'SOXL') || ' / ' || coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bear,ticker}', 'SOXS') = '$combo'),
rg AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT greatest(sel.started_ms, (CASE WHEN '${since}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${since}' <> '0' THEN '${since}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${since_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${since_hour}'::int ELSE 0 END * 3600000 ELSE 0 END)) AS from_ms, least(sel.end_ms + 1, (CASE WHEN '${until}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${until}'::bigint < 99999999999999 THEN '${until}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${until_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${until_hour}'::int ELSE 24 END * 3600000 ELSE 99999999999999 END)) AS to_ms FROM sel)
SELECT to_timestamp(o.submitted_ms / 1000.0) AS "Time", initcap(o.purpose) AS "Purpose", CASE o.leg WHEN 'bull' THEN '$bull' ELSE '$bear' END AS "Leg",
       initcap(o.side) || CASE WHEN o.reduce_only THEN ' · RO' ELSE '' END AS "Side", o.qty AS "Qty", o.cum_exec_qty AS "Filled",
       CASE o.leg WHEN 'bull' THEN to_char(o.price, 'FM9990.00') ELSE to_char(o.price, 'FM9990.000') END AS "Limit", CASE o.leg WHEN 'bull' THEN to_char(o.avg_price, 'FM9990.00') ELSE to_char(o.avg_price, 'FM9990.000') END AS "Avg", CASE WHEN o.cum_exec_qty = 0 THEN NULL WHEN NOT o.fee_known THEN -9100000000 ELSE -o.fee END AS "Fee",

panels.title: Positions Now · ct, USDT and Bps
panels.description:
Each leg at the Run's newest inventory sample (every 10 s), whatever the Range; the venue's figures live only (the paper venue reports positions alone).

- **Venue, Ledger**: the venue's position and the program's ledger (dust included), contracts, signed (+ long, − short); they must match.
- **Mark, Liq Price**: the venue's mark and liquidation price, USDT.

panels.description:
Each stage over the Run's orders submitted in the Range; paper: the configured simulated latency, not a measurement.

- **Clock**: local: this host's clock; venue: Bitget's.
- **Orders**: orders measured.
- **Median, P90, Max**: the median, 90th percentile and largest, ms.

targets.rawSql:
WITH sel AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.run_id, r.live, r.started_ms, r.stopped_ms, r.host, r.config, coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) AS end_ms

WITH sel AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.run_id, r.live, r.started_ms, r.stopped_ms, r.host, r.config, coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) AS end_ms

WITH sel AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.run_id, r.live, r.started_ms, r.stopped_ms, r.host, r.config, coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) AS end_ms
                         FROM trade.process_run r WHERE r.run_id = (SELECT CASE '$run' WHEN '__live' THEN (SELECT x.run_id FROM trade.process_run x WHERE x.live ORDER BY x.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1) WHEN '__paper' THEN (SELECT x.run_id FROM trade.process_run x WHERE NOT x.live ORDER BY x.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE '$run' END) AND coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bull,ticker}', 'SOXL') || ' / ' || coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bear,ticker}', 'SOXS') = '$combo'),
rg AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT greatest(sel.started_ms, (CASE WHEN '${since}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${since}' <> '0' THEN '${since}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${since_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${since_hour}'::int ELSE 0 END * 3600000 ELSE 0 END)) AS from_ms, least(sel.end_ms + 1, (CASE WHEN '${until}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${until}'::bigint < 99999999999999 THEN '${until}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${until_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${until_hour}'::int ELSE 24 END * 3600000 ELSE 99999999999999 END)) AS to_ms FROM sel)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT to_timestamp(f.settlement_ms / 1000.0) AS "Settlement", f.symbol AS "Contract", 'Booked' AS "Status", f.amount AS "Amount",
         f.cycle_id AS "Cycle"
  FROM trade.funding f WHERE f.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND f.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND f.settlement_ms >= (SELECT rg.from_ms FROM rg) AND f.settlement_ms < (SELECT rg.to_ms FROM rg)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT to_timestamp((a ->> 'settlement_ms')::bigint / 1000.0), CASE a ->> 'leg' WHEN 'bull' THEN '$bull' ELSE '$bear' END, 'Awaited', NULL,
         c.cycle_id
  FROM trade.cycle c CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(c.funding_awaited) a
  WHERE c.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND (c.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) OR c.cycle_id IN (SELECT dr.cycle_id FROM trade.decision dr WHERE dr.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND dr.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND dr.cycle_id IS NOT NULL)) AND jsonb_typeof(c.funding_awaited) = 'array') t
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL, NULL, 'None in the Range, none awaited', NULL, NULL
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trade.funding f WHERE f.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND f.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND f.settlement_ms >= (SELECT rg.from_ms FROM rg) AND f.settlement_ms < (SELECT rg.to_ms FROM rg))
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trade.cycle c WHERE c.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND (c.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) OR c.cycle_id IN (SELECT dr.cycle_id FROM trade.decision dr WHERE dr.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND dr.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND dr.cycle_id IS NOT NULL)) AND jsonb_typeof(c.funding_awaited) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(c.funding_awaited) > 0)
ORDER BY 1 DESC NULLS LAST

list.name: run
list.label: Run
list.description: The Run first: Newest Live Run (the default: the live run started last; a new start is followed by itself), Newest Paper Run, or one Run: Run nn (numbered by start, both modes) · Live or Paper · start – end (now while it runs) · running, stopped or lost (no stop recorded and no sample for a minute). One Run is one start of the program: one mode, one set of settings.
list.definition:
SELECT x.__text, x.__value FROM (
  SELECT 'Newest Live Run · ' || 'Run ' || lpad((SELECT count(*) FROM trade.process_run n WHERE (n.started_ms, n.run_id) <= (r.started_ms, r.run_id))::text, 2, '0') AS __text, '__live' AS __value, 2 AS g, 0::bigint AS o
  FROM (SELECT * FROM trade.process_run x WHERE x.live ORDER BY x.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1) r
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Newest Paper Run · ' || 'Run ' || lpad((SELECT count(*) FROM trade.process_run n WHERE (n.started_ms, n.run_id) <= (r.started_ms, r.run_id))::text, 2, '0'), '__paper', 1, 0 FROM (SELECT * FROM trade.process_run x WHERE NOT x.live ORDER BY x.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1) r
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Run ' || lpad((SELECT count(*) FROM trade.process_run n WHERE (n.started_ms, n.run_id) <= (r.started_ms, r.run_id))::text, 2, '0') || ' · ' || CASE WHEN r.live THEN 'Live' ELSE 'Paper' END || ' · ' || to_char(to_timestamp((r.started_ms) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'MM‑DD HH24:MI') || ' – ' || CASE WHEN q.state <> 'stopped' THEN 'now'
              WHEN to_char(to_timestamp((r.started_ms) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'MM‑DD') = to_char(to_timestamp((r.stopped_ms) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'MM‑DD') THEN to_char(to_timestamp((r.stopped_ms) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'HH24:MI') ELSE to_char(to_timestamp((r.stopped_ms) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'MM‑DD HH24:MI') END || ' · ' || q.state, r.run_id, 0, r.started_ms
  FROM trade.process_run r CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN r.stopped_ms IS NOT NULL THEN 'stopped' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trade.signal_sample s WHERE s.ts_ms > (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - 60000 AND s.run_id = r.run_id AND s.live = r.live) THEN 'running' WHEN (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms < 60000 THEN 'starting' ELSE 'lost' END AS state) q
  UNION ALL SELECT 'No Run Yet', '__none', 0, 0 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trade.process_run x)) x
ORDER BY x.g DESC, x.o DESC

list.name: since
list.label: Since
list.description: Where the figures start: Run start, or a UTC+8 date the Run ran on, at the hour on its right.
list.definition:

  UNION ALL SELECT d.day_ms::text, to_char(to_timestamp((d.day_ms) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'YYYY‑MM‑DD'), d.day_ms FROM (SELECT g::bigint AS day_ms FROM trade.process_run r,
  generate_series((floor((r.started_ms + 28800000) / 86400000.0) * 86400000 - 28800000)::bigint,
                  (floor((coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) + 28800000) / 86400000.0) * 86400000 - 28800000)::bigint, 86400000) g

list.label: Round Trip
list.description: The round trip whose orders are shown: the Range's newest (the default); a click on Opened in Round Trips, on a point of Net per Round Trip or on an alert's Source picks one.

list.label: Range

list.name: Long Round Trips

WITH sel AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.run_id, r.live, r.started_ms, r.stopped_ms, r.host, r.config, coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) AS end_ms

SELECT c.opened_ms AS time, coalesce(c.closed_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) AS time_end,
       initcap(c.direction) || ' ' || to_char(to_timestamp((c.opened_ms) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'HH24:MI:SS') || ' – ' || coalesce(to_char(to_timestamp((c.closed_ms) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'HH24:MI:SS'), 'open') || ' · ' || coalesce(CASE c.end_reason WHEN 'exit_line' THEN 'Exit Line' WHEN 'close_window' THEN 'Flattened Before Close' WHEN 'stop' THEN 'Program Stopped' WHEN 'session_changed' THEN 'Session Ended' WHEN 'no_fill' THEN 'No Fill' WHEN 'one_leg' THEN 'One Leg Only' WHEN 'dust_only' THEN 'Trimmed to Dust' WHEN 'store_error' THEN 'Not Recorded' ELSE initcap(replace(c.end_reason, '_', ' ')) END, 'Open') || ' · Net '
       || CASE WHEN c.status = 'open' THEN 'open' WHEN NOT c.funding_known THEN 'Pending' ELSE to_char(c.net, 'FM999,990.00') || ' USDT' END AS text
FROM trade.cycle c
WHERE c.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND (c.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) OR c.cycle_id IN (SELECT dr.cycle_id FROM trade.decision dr WHERE dr.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND dr.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND dr.cycle_id IS NOT NULL)) AND c.direction = 'long' AND c.end_reason IS DISTINCT FROM 'no_fill' AND c.opened_ms <= least($__to, (SELECT rg.to_ms FROM rg) - 1)

list.name: Anchor Changes
list.rawQuery:
WITH sel AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.run_id, r.live, r.started_ms, r.stopped_ms, r.host, r.config, coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) AS end_ms FROM trade.process_run r WHERE r.run_id = (SELECT CASE '$run' WHEN '__live' THEN (SELECT x.run_id FROM trade.process_run x WHERE x.live ORDER BY x.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1) WHEN '__paper' THEN (SELECT x.run_id FROM trade.process_run x WHERE NOT x.live ORDER BY x.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE '$run' END) AND coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bull,ticker}', 'SOXL') || ' / ' || coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bear,ticker}', 'SOXS') = '$combo'), rg AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT greatest(sel.started_ms, (CASE WHEN '${since}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${since}' <> '0' THEN '${since}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${since_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${since_hour}'::int ELSE 0 END * 3600000 ELSE 0 END)) AS from_ms, least(sel.end_ms + 1, (CASE WHEN '${until}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${until}'::bigint < 99999999999999 THEN '${until}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${until_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${until_hour}'::int ELSE 24 END * 3600000 ELSE 99999999999999 END)) AS to_ms FROM sel) SELECT x.ts_ms AS time, 'Anchor change · ' || CASE WHEN x.anchor_kind IS NULL THEN 'no anchor (Missing): no entries until one is read' WHEN x.ps IS DISTINCT FROM x.session_id THEN 'new session ' || x.session_id || ' (the close)
bell anchor (F × Binance''s index at the close; the NAV to follow)' WHEN x.pk IS NULL THEN 'an anchor read again' WHEN x.pk = 'bell' AND x.anchor_kind = 'nav' THEN 'NAV confirmed for session ' || x.session_id || '
